pyharp solves many atmospheric columns, wavelengths and bands in one call, and it can do so on an NVIDIA GPU. This
chapter states what that buys and what it does not. A batched call must give the same fluxes as a loop over single
columns, and a CUDA call the same fluxes as a CPU call, up to round-off. Both claims are measured here for each
solver and each precision. The DISORT solver comes from the separate package pydisort, so its CUDA support depends
on the pydisort version installed next to pyharp; the chapter measures the two versions a user meets, and it
shows what happens when pyharp and pydisort are built against different versions.

#| fig-alt: "Three boxes: the build on the left, with arrows to 'Toon: batch and CUDA' labelled 'enables CUDA kernels' and to 'DISORT on CUDA, by pydisort version' labelled 'selects pydisort'."

@fig-ch09-map shows the dependencies, and @tbl-ch09-schemes lists the sections.

Every number, table and figure of this chapter is regenerated by one command, `derivation-checks/ch09_run.sh
<setup root>`, which runs the five checks and rewrites their outputs and the support-matrix data. Its environments
are built from public pins only by `derivation-checks/ch09_setup.sh`: pyharp at the code pin with `-DCUDA=ON`,
pydisort 1.7.1 and 1.8.13 from their published wheels checked by hash, torch 2.10.0 with CUDA 12.6, and the two
mixed builds of @sec-ch09-build. With an nvcc older than 12.8 that script applies one patch to pyharp's CMake list
of CUDA architectures, `derivation-checks/ch09_setup/cuda-arch-sm120.patch`, without which the CUDA build fails;
it touches no source file. The second line of every output records the pyharp and pydisort commits, the torch
build, the CPU, the GPU and the compilers of the run.

| section | option | default | main check |
|---|---|---|---|
| @sec-ch09-toon | device and precision of the inputs | CPU, as given | `check_ch09_batch_device.py` |
| @sec-ch09-disort | `solver: disort`; installed pydisort | CPU | `check_ch09_batch_device.py`, `check_ch09_matrix.py` |
| @sec-ch09-build | `-DCUDA=ON`; `pydisort>=1.7.1` | CUDA off | `check_ch09_abi.py`, `check_ch09_d1.sh` |
